The audit will begin shortly after Aug. 20 and take "several months," delaying Batch Zero classification and the planned September study start. But ERCOT is taking steps to preserve Q1/Q2 2027 energization dates for the most advanced projects -->

ERCOT doesn't identify the six Q1 projects, so we can't confirm Beacon Point is among them. But it fits the profile.)

The defining feature of the subprime bubble was credit extended without verified income to service it: No-income/no-doc mortgages were then pooled, securitized, tranched and spread throughout the global financial system.

The closest data-center equivalent would be a loan against unleased powered land, with no tenant, no rent and no income.
